name: – Ralf Seekatz – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on Banking Union – annual report 2024
part_text:
The report is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It calls for finishing the Banking Union by adding a common European deposit insurance scheme, so savers' deposits are protected the same way in every member state. It asks for simpler rules so EU banks can compete better, for banks to keep leaving Russia, and for careful handling of crypto-assets and cyber threats. It also says decisions on a digital euro should be made by elected lawmakers, not only the central bank.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament sets out its position and asks the Commission and Council to act.
- **Who it affects:** Banks, savers, small businesses and households across the EU.
- **What happens next:** Talks with member states on a European deposit insurance scheme, which has stalled since 2015.
